LESSON: WRITING 12.4.1 GUIDED COMPOSITION

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: ENGLISH LANGUAGE
Strand: Strand 12
Topic 12.4: Writing 12.4.1 Guided Composition

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Writing 12.4.1 Guided Composition. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: Why should we keep a record of what we do? 2. What information do we record?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify the components of a diary for effective writing,
2. write a diary in the right format for effective communication,

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: When you meet your teacher in the morning, say “Good morning” clearly and smile.

Example 2: Listen to a short story about a child walking to school. Then tell a friend one thing that happened.

Example 3: Write three sentences about your school using new words from this lesson.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Writing 12.4.1 Guided Composition.
2. Explain Writing 12.4.1 Guided Composition to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Try this activity: view samples of diaries and discuss them with peers,
4. Show that you can: identify the components of a diary for effective writing,
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Writing 12.4.1 Guided Composition. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: Why should we keep a record of what we do? 2. What information do we record?
